title: Datasource spec
description: A connection spec. Secrets are referenced by ${ENV_VAR} placeholders and resolved from the environment at apply — never stored in the file.

type.description: Connector kind, e.g. snowflake | databricks | postgres | sql | csv | parquet | json | excel.

file.description: For a file-based type (csv/parquet/json/…): path to a LOCAL file, relative to this datasource file. At apply, `px` uploads it to the workspace disk and connects it. Omit for connection-style sources.

diskPath.description: Optional subdirectory under the workspace disk/ to upload `file` into (must exist server-side).
